mit_stanford_fast_charge.eol_threshold: 0.88 Ah, equal to 80% of 1.1 Ah nominal capacity
mit_stanford_fast_charge.cycle_count_origin: 1-based physical cycle count; cycle 1 trace omitted, observed traces begin at cycle 2

oxford_battery_degradation_1.cycle_life: first observed cycle where capacity/first-complete-cycle capacity <= 0.80
oxford_battery_degradation_1.eol_threshold: 80% of each cell's first complete observed-cycle capacity
oxford_battery_degradation_1.cycle_count_origin: physical cycle counter begins at 0 in the canonical source
oxford_battery_degradation_1.sampling_protocol: diagnostic observations approximately every 100 physical cycles

noncomparability_reasons: different EOL capacity reference (nominal versus first observed cycle)
substantially different lifetime ranges and cell domains
